purpose: Exact team identity matching only; these current cached names are not historical prediction features.
rules: Join cached ESPN competitor.team.id to frozen cfb:<id> team IDs.
Use only displayName, shortDisplayName and location; never mascot-only name or inferred abbreviations.
Normalize using research.odds_history._name before checking collisions.
Check names against all cached CFB teams and all frozen 2025 canonical names, including teams outside the target season.
Omit names claimed by more than one ESPN team ID; no fuzzy matching.
Each alias retains its first observed source and field; raw source files are identified by immutable commit and SHA256.
